text: Academic Success Coaching. Need to improve your study habits? Academic Success Coaching is the one-on-one process of helping students devise a personalized approach to studying. This program serves as a general resource, where students can receive help with various school-related topics such as: Time management Prioritizing assignments/tasks Effective study strategies Note-taking strategies Goal setting Study environment tips Test taking tips Academic Success Coaching offers in-person appointments for currently enrolled undergraduate students. If you would like to partner with an Academic Success Coach to discuss any of the ASC topics, please visit Accudemia to schedule an appointment today! Please note: If you are seeking academic support and are not sure where to start, a good place to visit is the Student Success Center. We will be happy to help you or refer you to the many campus resources that are here to support you in your academic journey. · · ·
